snippet.title: Zomb Zerro 999 – Official Steam Trailer | VR Horror Demo Coming Soon
snippet.description:
The secret base is no longer silent.

Official trailer for Zomb Zerro 999, a VR psychological horror game where isolation, fear, and ritual merge deep underground.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673040/Zomb_Zerro__999_Demo/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demotrailer

You are Sam Keller, a technician tasked with investigating a remote mountain facility. But something ancient has awakened.

Explore the base
Uncover its secrets
Survive the supernatural

 Demo coming to Steam in August 2025

———
Developed by: Apex Aurora Games
#ZombZerro999 #VRHorror #IndieHorror #SteamDemo #WishlistNow
